dataSources.name: Job portal postings
dataSources.description: Synthetic extract in the shape of job-portal vacancy listings. Stands in for portal data until a real feed is agreed.

dataSources.name: Employment exchange vacancies (NCS-style)
dataSources.description: Synthetic extract shaped like National Career Service vacancy registrations with NCO codes. No connection to NCS exists yet.

dataSources.name: Industry hiring intent
dataSources.description: Synthetic employer hiring-intent scores (0–100) by role and location.

dataSources.name: Industry demand outlook survey
dataSources.description: Synthetic sector-skill-council style outlook scores (0–100) by trade and district.

dataSources.name: Training capacity and outcomes
dataSources.description: Synthetic seat allocation, enrolment, completion and placement by trade and district. Stands in for scheme MIS data.

dataSources.name: NCO-2015 / NSQF classification
dataSources.description: Indicative mapping of pilot trades to NCO-2015 unit groups and NSQF levels, built by hand for the prototype. Needs validation against the official registers.

dataSources.name: National Career Service (NCS)
dataSources.description: Planned source for vacancy and jobseeker registrations. Not connected.
dataSources.feeds: Would replace the synthetic employment-exchange extract

dataSources.name: e-Shram
dataSources.description: Planned source for the registered unorganised workforce by occupation and district. Not connected.
dataSources.feeds: Would add available workforce to the supply side

dataSources.name: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)
dataSources.description: Planned source for employment structure by occupation and region, to benchmark demand levels. Not connected.
dataSources.granularity: State × occupation group × quarter or year

dataSources.name: Scheme MIS (Skill India Digital Hub and state systems)
dataSources.description: Planned source for sanctioned seats, enrolment, certification and placement. Not connected.
dataSources.feeds: Would replace the synthetic training-capacity extract
